::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Hyderabad startup founded in 2024 to design gallium-nitride power amplifiers and RF front-end ICs (amplifiers, beamformers, switches) for radar, satellite communication and wireless networks; lists support under the Startup India Seed Fund Scheme. Its site lists product categories but no part numbers, and says product images are conceptual. Production status not disclosed.
:::

## What does this firm design?

GaN power amplifiers, RF switches and front-end ICs for radar, satcom and 5G.
